prompt_en: Create a photorealistic, non-explicit fashion editorial inside a decommissioned alpine funicular station in late-night fog with distant harbor rain. A clearly 32-year-old female cinema-restoration specialist, whose facial appearance follows an adult facial-appearance reference only, stands at a brass-latticed ticket-booth threshold; one identifiable adult target remains in frame: the same clearly 37-year-old male cinematheque curator. Her irises head and torso converge toward the same target, the adult man at the threshold. She holds the threshold open with one shoulder while extending a silver film canister toward him across the deliberately empty half of a luggage trolley. She holds the threshold open for the same target and extends a silver film canister toward him; the adult target pauses and reaches toward the invitation, one open hand aimed at the canister. A brass signal key and cyanotype route map lie beside the canister. Frame both adults, threshold, canister, trolley gap, and reaching hands in a vertical two-shot from doorway height on a 28 mm lens. Warm tungsten booth light and cold skylight flashes meet on the wet floor. She wears an oxblood satin blouse under charcoal wool-gabardine tailoring. Both adults remain fully dressed.
